source.title: Lattice Boltzmann Method with regularized non-equilibrium distribution functions

used: Equations6 and10: fneq=f-feq, Pi_neq=Pi-Pi_eq; stress-based reconstruction w_i Q_i:Pi_neq/(2cs^4). Rationale for filtering nonhydrodynamic moments while preserving hydrodynamic moments.
difference: The paper regularizes the pre-collision distribution in BGK. This experiment leaves cumulant collision untouched and uses a separately derived factorized covariance reconstruction at the outer boundary only. No precision/stability claims from the paper are transferred to this implementation.
not_used: The paper's numerical cavity/Kovasznay/3D turbulence comparisons are not experimental truth for this project and are not new validation cases.
